claims.text: Andaman Polymer Group has revised the mechanical completion schedule for its third polypropylene line at Map Ta Phut from the second quarter of 2028 to the fourth quarter of 2028.

citations.quote: mechanical completion has moved from the second quarter of 2028 to the fourth quarter of 2028

claims.text: The delay in the schedule was attributed to two factors: a longer-than-expected environmental permit amendment process for the revised flare tie-in, and a civil contractor's request for a schedule extension due to unsuitable ground conditions requiring additional piling.

citations.quote: environmental permit amendment covering the revised flare tie-in took longer than the company had assumed... civil contractor requested a schedule extension after encountering unsuitable ground conditions at the foundation stage, which required additional piling

claims.text: The capital estimate for the third polypropylene line remains unchanged despite the schedule delay.

citations.quote: Andaman said the capital estimate is unchanged

claims.text: The delay does not affect the existing two polypropylene lines or the Map Ta Phut cracker.

citations.quote: the delay does not affect the existing two polypropylene lines or the cracker

claims.text: The most recent public information from Andaman Polymer Group sets mechanical completion for the third polypropylene line at Map Ta Phut in the fourth quarter of 2028.

citations.quote: mechanical completion has moved from the second quarter of 2028 to the fourth quarter of 2028

claims.text: The original schedule, as of January 2026, targeted mechanical completion in the second quarter of 2028 and first production in 2028.

citations.quote: mechanical completion: Q2 2028... First production was targeted for 2028.

gaps.subject: Expected commissioning or startup date beyond mechanical completion
gaps.detail: No public information is available specifying the commissioning or startup date for the third polypropylene line beyond the revised mechanical completion schedule.

coverage_note: Schedule coverage is current as of July 2026, with the latest update from Andaman Polymer Group. No commissioning or startup date has been publicly confirmed beyond the revised mechanical completion timeline.
